works.abstract: The growing environmental concerns regarding plastic waste have led to significant advancements in the development of biodegradable plastics. Biodegradable plastics offer a sustainable alternative to conventional plastics, as they decompose naturally over time, reducing pollution and minimizing environmental impact. This article explores the key advancements in the production of biodegradable plastics, including the use of renewable raw materials, innovative production processes, and the development of new biodegradable polymers. The article also examines the challenges and future prospects of biodegradable plastics in achieving widespread adoption as an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional plastics.
works.title: Advancements in Biodegradable Plastics: A Sustainable Solution
